title: search.placeEventCounts
description: The places with the most matching events, with the number of events on each place.

totalEvents.description: All events that match the filters, including online events, events without coordinates and events on places outside the list. It is not the sum of the `eventCount` of the places.

places.description: At most 50 places, the place with the most events first. Only places with coordinates are included.

name.description: Name of the place per language. Empty when the place has no name.

eventCount.description: Number of matching events on this place. With large result sets the count can be slightly too low.
